name: EPIC 229033251
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 15.5 solar radii and 1.02 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 11,782 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.02 solar masses and 15.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,920 K at its surface.
